title: Rochdale arts leader Parvez Qadir wins This Is Manchester award
excerpt: The founder of Rochdale-based Breaking Barriers has been recognised for making a difference through arts and community work.
body:
Rochdale arts leader Parvez Qadir has won the Individual Making a Difference award at the This Is Manchester Awards 2026.

The artistic director and founder of Breaking Barriers received the award. His win is listed on the awards organiser’s official winners page.

Qadir established the Rochdale-based production company. It uses arts and culture to bring people together and create opportunities for communities whose voices are often underrepresented.

In its announcement of the award, Breaking Barriers said it had delivered projects and reached young people through Theatre in Education programmes.

The award brings recognition to a locally founded organisation working with residents, artists and young people.
